lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗?

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 想说点什么?

lines.en: : {i}Sorry to be the bearer of bad news but...no.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}很抱歉要带来坏消息……不。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That could have been the easiest lie of your life nope fuck Imani I guess.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那本可以是你人生中最轻松的一个谎。不。操。我想我只好认了,Imani。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do you really care that much?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真这么在意吗?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}OBVIOUSLY. Do you think I'd be a student for Halloween if I was comfortable with how quickly I am DYING?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}显然。要是我能坦然面对自己 DYING 的速度,我会在万圣节扮成学生吗?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}One thousand yen says I'm dying faster.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一千日元赌我死得更快。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That does not make my impending death any better!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这丝毫没有让我迫近的死期更好受!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}In fact, it makes it worse because you were going to be the one to give my eulogy!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}事实上更糟了,因为本来要念我悼词的人是你!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why me?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么是我?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Because Rika is an idiot, Wakana is too gloomy, and Osako is too busy fawning over how gloomy Wakana is.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为 Rika 是个白痴,Wakana 太阴郁,而 Osako 正忙着对着「阴郁的 Wakana」大献殷勤。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Have Kirin do it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}让 Kirin 来念。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Kirin would straight crawl into my coffin and fuck my dead body.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Kirin 会直接爬进我的棺材,上我的尸体。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I wouldn't?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那我就不会?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You know maybe I'll just pre-record my own eulogy and have somebody play the tape.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道吗,也许我干脆提前录好自己的悼词,找个人放录音。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Where'd you even get that uniform?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你这套制服到底哪来的?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Custom ordered BIATCH.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}定制下单的,姐们儿!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I thought the school refused to let you get one.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我记得学校拒绝给你配制服。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I may have fabricated an application for a new uniform on behalf of a certain delinquent.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也许以某个不良少女的名义,伪造了一份新制服申请。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Imani...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Imani……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}WHAT she wasn't going to submit one and this was my only chance!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}怎么了嘛!她又不会自己交申请,这是我唯一的机会!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You could have just gotten one with different colors.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你完全可以弄一件颜色不同的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But then I wouldn't fit in and the girls wouldn't acknowledge me as one of their own!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那我就融不进去了,女孩们也不会承认我是她们的一员!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}They acknowledge Yasu and her colors are black and white.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她们承认 Yasu,而她的配色是黑白。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay, but, let's be real. Do they REALLY acknowledge Yasu??? Or do they just let her exist{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好吧,但现实点。她们真的「承认」Yasu 吗???还是只是放任她存在{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sounds like a form of acknowledgement to me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}听起来也算一种承认。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Say, when are you going to get a cool new uniform? I want to see you in our colors.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}话说,你什么时候弄一身帅气的制服?我想看你穿我们的颜色。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I think you could pull it off. And I'm not just saying that because I've got a thing for dudes in uniforms.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得你撑得起来。我不只是因为喜欢穿制服的男人才这么说。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Which I do just FYI.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}顺带一提,我确实喜欢。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Same.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也是。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Bro you gay???{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哥,你是弯的???{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sorry, I meant girls in uniform.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抱歉,我是说穿制服的女孩。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Awww Senpai :D{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哎呀,Senpai :D{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sorry, I meant girls in uniforms they did not acquire via dubious means.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抱歉,我是说穿制服的女孩——制服来源得正当。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Awww Senpai D:{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哎呀,Senpai D:{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Imani, you're like 20.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Imani,你都二十岁左右了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm older than 20 but even THAT is too old! I want to be 15 again!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我二十好几了,但连那都太老!我想重新变回 15 岁!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why in the world would anyone ever want that?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}世上怎么会有人想要那种事?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Because being an adult fucking SUCKS man we've gotta pay taxes and sign our name on a bunch of shit.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为成年他妈的烂透了,老兄,我们得交税,还得在一堆破事上签名。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If I was 15, all I'd have to sign my name on would be tests. Tests that I'd get an A on since you'd be my teacher.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我要是 15 岁,需要签名的就只有试卷。还是你会给我打 A 的试卷。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How come you get to revert to a younger age but I have to stay the same?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么你能变回更小的年纪,我却必须保持原样?{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hey if you can figure out a way to get both of us back to 15 I will gladly resume this friendship in our smaller forms.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿,你要是能想出办法让我们俩都变回 15 岁,我很乐意以更小的形态重启这段友情。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But if just one of us is going back, I call shotgun.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}但要是只能回去一个,那我先占。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But don't worry, we can still chill. I'm sure YOU wouldn't mind.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过别担心,我们照样能一起玩。我确信「你」不会介意。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}All seriousness though, I wonder if we would have been friends if we went to school together.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过说正经的,我在想,要是我们一起上过学,我们会成为朋友吗。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Guessing you'd be the gloomy kid sitting in the back of the classroom.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我猜你会是那个坐在教室后排的阴郁小孩。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Omg which would mean I would be the super popular girl who starts hanging out with you despite everyone being like UHHH IMANI WHY HE IS WEIRD{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}天哪,那就是说,我会是那个超受欢迎的女孩——不顾所有人「呃啊 IMANI 他好怪」的反对,开始和你厮混{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And then you'd be all like I HAVE A DARK PAST{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}然后你就会来一句「我有一段黑暗的过去」{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I'd be all like I CAN FIX YOU{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}然后我就会来一句「我能治好你」{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then we'd bang or something idk{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}然后我们就睡了之类的,不知道{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You should write a book.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你该去写本书。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And you should invent a time machine.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而你该去发明时光机。{/i}
